resources.string: HorizonCam uses the camera to show the viewfinder and to take your photos and videos.
Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings to use HorizonCam.

• The horizon button (top left) chooses Off, Steady, or Steady + horizon lock. Its line shows the horizon your video will have. • The frame button (bottom left) records landscape while you hold the phone upright, or portrait while you hold it sideways. • Quick controls (bottom right): torch, sound, timer, ratio, video size, brightness and guides. Drag the panel down to close it.
Gestures • Tap to focus, then drag up or down to change the brightness. Touch and hold to lock focus and exposure. • Swipe left or right, or drag the mode names, to change mode. Swipe up or down to switch cameras. • Drag sideways on the zoom buttons, or pinch, to zoom. • While recording, you can pause and take photos from the video. • The volume keys take a photo or start recording.
Horizon lock is on. Tilt or turn your phone: your video stays level. Tap to close.
Steady is on: small tilts are straightened. Tap the horizon button for more. Tap to close.
